items.title: Ketegangan Malaysia dan Norwegia Meningkat Karena Dibatalkannya Kesepakatan Rudal
items.summary: Tensions between Malaysia and Norway heightened over a scrapped weapons deal as Oslo confirmed it had revoked export licenses tied to a naval strike missile system.

items.title: Filipina Meminta Pengadilan Menolak Petisi Senator yang Dicari ICC
items.summary: The Philippine government asked the Supreme Court to deny a petition by Senator Ronald Dela Rosa to stop his arrest after the International Criminal Court issued a warrant on allegations of crimes against humanity.

items.title: Malaysia Mengumumkan Langkah-Langkah untuk Membantu Maskapai Penerbangan yang Terkena Perang Iran
items.summary: Malaysia introduced measures to ensure the operational stability of its aviation industry and ease the financial strain on airlines as they struggle with the impact of war in the Middle East.

items.title: WHO Menyatakan Darurat Kesehatan Global Wabah Ebola di Kongo
items.summary: The World Health Organization declared an Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, warning that a rare virus strain with no approved vaccine or treatment may already be spreading more widely than detected.

items.title: Perlombaan Inventaris Global Meningkat di Tengah Bayangan Perang Iran
items.summary: The global rush to stockpile manufactured goods on fears of an energy-supply crunch will again overshadow business surveys in the coming week gauging the impact of a third month of war in the Middle East.

items.title: BDC Publik Menghargai Rasa Sakit Paling Banyak Sejak Covid
items.summary: Private credit’s aggressive push to court retail investors has exposed the industry to a less familiar threat: public market volatility, which is dragging business development company shares toward their steepest discounts relative to their assets since the pandemic.

items.title: Video serangan drone Hizbullah menunjukkan taktik yang berkembang melawan Israel
items.summary: BBC Verify has examined dozens of videos of fibre-optic drone attacks carried out by the Lebanese armed group.

items.title: Taiwan menegaskan negaranya independen setelah peringatan Trump
items.summary: Fresh from his summit in Beijing, the US president warned against a formal declaration of independence by the island.

items.title: Pemimpin senior ISIS tewas dalam operasi gabungan, kata AS dan Nigeria
items.summary: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

items.title: Balita termasuk di antara lebih dari 50 anak sekolah yang diculik di Nigeria
items.summary: No group has yet claimed responsibility for the attacks, which have devastated Mussa town in Borno state.

items.title: Pertentangan kepemimpinan Partai Buruh menempatkan Brexit kembali menjadi sorotan politik
items.summary: The UK's relationship with the EU is shaping up as a key issue for a possible Labour leadership contest and the coming by-election in the Makerfield.

items.title: Perang Iran langsung: Teheran merencanakan korban jiwa di Hormuz; Trump memperingatkan ‘waktu yang sangat buruk’
items.summary: Iran to reveal its plan for Strait of Hormuz soon as Israel attacks Lebanon and Gaza, killing and wounding dozens.

items.title: Tentara Bolivia berupaya membersihkan jalan setelah 11 hari protes
items.summary: Military police in Bolivia arrested demonstrators, and used tear gas to disrupt road blockades after 11 days of protests

items.title: Ribuan orang melakukan protes di final Eurovision ketika lima negara memboikot Israel
items.summary: Spain, Ireland, Iceland, Slovenia and Netherlands all withdrew in protest against Israel's participation amid Gaza war.

items.title: 5 perpindahan uang yang membuat ayah berusia 32 tahun ini menjadi jutawan hanya dalam 9 tahun
items.summary: A low starting salary, global pandemic, unaffordable housing market, graduate school and two kids didn’t stop Blake Edwards and his wife from becoming millionaires by their early 30s.

items.title: Lonjakan inflasi di bulan April membuat Warsh dan The Fed tidak memiliki alasan untuk tidak menaikkan suku bunga
items.summary: Bond markets won’t wait for the central bank to combat inflation.

items.title: UEA mengatakan keputusannya untuk meninggalkan OPEC adalah langkah ekonomi strategis, bukan politik
items.summary: The United Arab Emirates, which joined OPEC in 1967, announced last month it was leaving the oil producer group on May 1.
